documents.title: Board Meeting Intimation for Quarterly Results For Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026

analysis.summary: During the financial year 2025-26, GNA Axles experienced a 4% decline in net revenue to ` 1,478.42 crores due to export pressures from U.S. tariffs, though domestic demand for tractors and commercial vehicles remained robust. Management actively improved operational efficiency, optimized capacity utilization, and controlled costs, resulting in a higher profit after tax of ` 116.99 crores. The company is strategically expanding its presence in light and passenger vehicles, particularly via GNA Mobility Limited, and aims to drive future growth through new product development, automation, and export market revival. GNA Axles Limited reported net operating revenue of Rs 153,974.07 lacs and an EBITDA of Rs 210.61 cr for the financial year 2024-25.

guidance.claim: Domestic tractor market sales are expected to post a lower single-digit growth in the year due to expected good monsoon and higher farm incomes.
guidance.quote: As far as the Domestic Tractor Market is concerned we expect that the domestic sales are expected to post a lower single digit growth in this year as the Country expects a good monsoon this year which is expected to increase higher farm incomes and a lift in the rural economy.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for Commercial Vehicles is expected to improve from FY 2024-25 driven by promising GDP growth, government incentives, and continuing infrastructure focus.
demand_outlook.quote: With promising GDP growth outlook, incentives from government to improve productivity in both manufacturing and agriculture sectors, and continuing focus on infra, demand for CVs is expected to improve from FY 2024-25.

demand_outlook.claim: The management remains cautiously optimistic about domestic demand while monitoring geopolitical developments, interest rates, fuel prices, and inflation.
demand_outlook.quote: We remain cautiously optimistic about domestic demand while keeping a close watch on geopolitical developments, interest rates, fuel prices and inflation.

capex_expansion.claim: In 2025, GNA Mobility Limited was incorporated as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand the presence in automotive components.
capex_expansion.quote: In 2025, we incorporated GNA Mobility Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand our presence in automotive components.

capex_expansion.claim: Rooftop solar capacity was enhanced to 6 MW in 2025-26.
capex_expansion.quote: Our rooftop solar capacity has grown from 1.2 MW in 2023-24 to 6 MW in 2025-26, reinforcing our commitment to clean energy and sustainable growth.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that a 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution.
capex_expansion.quote: Continuing this trajectory, a 3 MW rooftop solar project is currently under execution, reinforcing our dedication to expanding clean energy infrastructure.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand solar capacity further in 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

margins_costs.claim: The company reported an EBITDA margin of 13.68% for the year 2024-25.

orders_capacity.claim: Roof solar capacity reached 6 MW in 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: Enhanced our rooftop solar capacity to 6 MW

orders_capacity.claim: The company reported selling 3,882,041 rear axle shafts, 1,105,733 spindles, and 327,019 other shafts in 2024-25.
orders_capacity.quote:
3,882,041 Rear Axle Shafts Sold in 2024-25
1,105,733 Spindles sold in 2024-25
327,019 Other Shafts sold in 2024-25

orders_capacity.claim: Total volume of products sold in domestic and export markets reached 51.10 lakh pieces in FY 2023-24.

management_commitments.claim: The company plans to expand solar capacity further in 2024-25.
management_commitments.quote: This year, we installed a 1.4 MW rooftop solar power project, and we’re planning to expand our solar capacity even further in 2024-25.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
